verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI is itself a coding agent, which makes it an MCP client rather than something that serves tools to other agents. The evidence shows only client-side MCP use: configuring and connecting MCP servers in settings.json and the /mcp command. Nothing shows Gemini CLI running as an MCP server, such as a serve subcommand or a hosted endpoint, so the server axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
